our_title: dgraphBand2Coll()/Ptop() allocation failure not agreed upon in release builds: the other processes hang
ran:
$WORK/repro/common/scan.sh $WORK/pristinefi/lib ./bin_pristinefi/g21fi 2 1 3 4 -- band path 0 8 2
  nth=3 exit=124 HANG :: (1): ERROR: SCOTCH_dgraphBand: out of memory (1); (1): ERROR: dgraphBand2Coll: out of memory (1); rank 1: band rc=1
  nth=4 exit=124 HANG :: (1): ERROR: dgraphBand2Coll: out of memory (1); rank 1: band rc=1
$WORK/repro/common/scan.sh ... 2 1 3 3 -- grow ring 0 8 2 -> nth=3 HANG (dgraphGrow2Coll); $WORK/repro/common/scan.sh ... 2 1 0 1 -- bandint path 0 8 2 -> nth=0,1 HANG
Patched: rc=1 on all ranks (scans/fix1_band_path_b0.txt, fix1_grow_ring_b0.txt, fix1_bandint_path_b0.txt, fix1_bandint_sparse_b1.txt).
evidence: l.145 `#ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1                       /* Communication not needed and not absorbable by the algorithm */\n  reduloctab[0] = reduglbtab[0]; ... MPI_Allreduce (reduloctab, reduglbtab, 3, GNUM_MPI, MPI_MAX, grafptr->proccomm) ... #endif` so that in release builds reduglbtab[0] is the local flag only; dgraph_band.c:157 `/* Error will be propagated by dgraphBand2*() */` shows the intent

fix_options.label: A: perform the 3-Gnum agreement (error flag + distance bounds) in all build modes
fix_options.summary: drop the #ifdef, reduce reduloctab unconditionally, treat a communication error as an error, keep the distance consistency check (distmax is a user parameter of SCOTCH_dgraphGrow())
fix_options.tested: injection above; 32-bit ASan+UBSan and 64-bit Gnum trees: all 15 CHECKPTSCOTCH targets (np=3) rc=0, the dgraph test programs and dgpart/dgord/dgtst at np 1, 2, 4 rc=0, `make ptcheck` rc=0, zero sanitizer reports (chk_32/chk_64_summary.txt); -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL tree: dgraph targets rc=0 (chk_dbg_summary.txt); 0 build warnings in all trees
fix_options.tradeoffs: one 3-Gnum MPI_Allreduce per band/grow call in release builds (the maintainer's comment explicitly avoided it); invalid distance parameters are now rejected in release builds too
fix_options.maintainer_fit: same decision as G18's dgraphRedist and G19's dgraphBuild3 commits in the combined base ('make error handling ... collective in all build modes', after hdgraphGather()); STYLE.md: a user-controlled parameter is checked unconditionally

fix_options.label: B: agree on the error flag only, keep the distance check debug-only
fix_options.summary: 1-Gnum reduction in release, 3 in debug, through a REDUNBR macro
fix_options.tradeoffs: two more #ifdef blocks to save 16 bytes per reduction
fix_options.maintainer_fit: more conditional code than he writes for such checks

our_title: Unchecked shrinking reallocs of the coarse edge arrays and multinode array: crash or silently inconsistent coarse graph with rc=0
ran:
$WORK/repro/common/scan.sh $WORK/pristinefi/lib ./bin_pristinefi/g21fi 2 1 26 27 -- coarsen ring 0 8 0
  nth=26 exit=1 :: MPI_ERRORS_ARE_FATAL (edge array replaced by NULL - baseval)
  nth=27 exit=0 :: (0): ERROR: dgraphCheck: inconsistent global graph data (2); (1): ERROR: dgraphCheck: inconsistent global graph data (2); rank 0,1: coarsen rc=0   <- rc=0 with an edge load array missing on one process
$WORK/repro/common/scan.sh ... 2 1 13 13 -- coarsen ring 1 8 1 -> nth=13 exit=139 :: dgraph_coarsen.c:908:51: runtime error: member access within null pointer of type 'const struct DgraphCoarsenMulti' (multinode array lost by its shrink)
Patched: the same reallocs (now nth=20,21 / fold nth=8) give rc=0 with check=0 on every rank (scans/fix2_coarsen_ring_b0.txt and a direct run in repro/PS2-G21-2/README).

fix_options.label: A: keep the arrays as they are when shrinking fails
fix_options.summary: temporary pointer, assign only on success (edge arrays after the final agreement; multinode array in dgraphCoarsen)
fix_options.tested: injection above; 32-bit ASan+UBSan and 64-bit Gnum trees: all 15 CHECKPTSCOTCH targets (np=3) rc=0, the dgraph test programs and dgpart/dgord/dgtst at np 1, 2, 4 rc=0, `make ptcheck` rc=0, zero sanitizer reports (chk_32/chk_64_summary.txt); -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL tree: dgraph targets rc=0 (chk_dbg_summary.txt); 0 build warnings in all trees
fix_options.tradeoffs: the physical arrays may stay larger than edgelocsiz/multlocnbr (harmless: sizes are logical)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: G19's dgraphGhst2() in the combined base ('Shrink send index array; keep it as is if shrinking fails'), the pattern G19 recorded tree-wide as PS2-G19-6

fix_options.label: B: treat a failed shrink as an error
fix_options.tradeoffs: fails for nothing (a larger array is usable), needs its own agreement between collectives, leaks the array

our_title: CONTEXTINIT() ignores the result of contextOptionsInit(): a failed options allocation runs the routine with defaults and rc=0
ran:
$WORK/repro/common/scan.sh $WORK/pristinefi/lib ./bin_pristinefi/g21fi 2 1 0 0 -- band path 0 8 2
  nth=0 exit=0 :: (1): ERROR: contextValuesInit: out of memory; rank 0: band rc=0; rank 1: band rc=0   (same for grow and coarsen, every SCOTCH_* routine using CONTEXTINIT)
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/context.h:109-118 (CONTEXTINIT macro; not a file of this group)
evidence: context.h:114-118 `: (c##_contptr = (void *) &c##_contdat,      \\\n      c##_cdatptr = (void *) (c),               \\\n      contextInit        (&c##_contdat),        \\\n      contextOptionsInit (&c##_contdat),        \\\n      contextCommit      (&c##_contdat)))` : a comma expression whose value is contextCommit()'s only

fix_options.label: A (notes only, other group's file): fold the result of contextOptionsInit() into the macro value
fix_options.tested: untested: sketch, not part of this series
fix_options.tradeoffs: contextExit() must tolerate a context without option values (not checked); behaviour change: routines fail instead of silently running with default options
fix_options.maintainer_fit: to be decided by the CTX group
